definitions.explanation: The position or side that is directly across from something.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}の{向|む}かいに{銀行|ぎんこう}がある。
examples.english: There's a bank across from the station.

examples.japanese: {向|む}かいの{家|いえ}に{新|あたら}しい{人|ひと}が{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}してきた。
examples.english: New people moved into the house across the street.

examples.japanese: {向|む}かい{側|がわ}に{渡|わた}ってください。
examples.english: Please cross to the other side.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{向|む}かいの〜 (the ~ across the way)
・{向|む}かい{側|がわ} (the opposite side, across)
・{向|む}かい{合|あ}う (to face each other)
・{向|む}かい{合|あ}わせ (facing each other)

RELATED VERB:
・{向|む}かう (to head toward, to face)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{向|む}こう (over there, the other side)
・{正面|しょうめん} (directly in front)
